full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D063.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
EXACT STRUCTURE AND STROKE INVENTORY:
1. THX, CCZ, QJZ available; DYC blank. THREE left ritual descenders, center attached to long lower bar; short detached upper bar is shorter.
2. RIGHT component MUST HAVE FIVE separate downward ends. From LEFT TO RIGHT within this right component: (1) SHORT DETACHED LEFT FLANKING stroke; (2) LONG stem curving LEFT at bottom; (3) LONG middle leg descending from a short upper bridge; (4) LONG independent tall stem curving RIGHT at bottom; (5) SHORT DETACHED RIGHT FLANKING stroke.
3. Critical missing-stroke prevention: the short LEFT flank of the right component is an EXTRA independent vertical BETWEEN the ritual radical's rightmost descender and the long connected main stem. Do NOT count the radical's rightmost stroke as this flank. Both must be visible separately with a gap. There are EIGHT downward ends across the whole glyph.
4. Only two tall central upper tips within the right component. The middle long leg begins from a rightward bridge attached to the left main tall stem at upper-third height. The other tall stem is fully detached.
5. Both short flank strokes end distinctly above the lowest THREE central legs. No box, counter or extra crossbar. Allow enough horizontal space for all eight lower strokes; avoid merging adjacent descenders.
Draw the EXTRA SHORT LEFT FLANK clearly. Approximate placement if useful: ritual descenders on left; extra short right-component LEFT flank near49%canvas width; connected mainstem near56%; middle leg near63%; independent mainstem near70%; short right flank near77%. Keep thin uniform strokes about30pixels per1024canvas so these gaps remain open. Compare all available actual specimens, preserve every end.
